title: iOS web-contract snapshot picks up the RF-132 likes paging and search contract
acceptance: An iOS PR re-copies apps/api/openapi/openapi.json from ritmofit-web main into ritmofit-ios/web-contract/ using the refresh block in web-contract/README.md and updates its provenance line; the snapshot then documents the likes ?cursor= and ?q= parameters and the X-RitmoFit-Next-Cursor header.
The iOS cross-repo parity check passes on that PR, and any iOS wire model that decodes the likes response is reconciled or confirmed unaffected.
nextAction: Owed since RF-132 merged (#665, d888d28) changed the likes contract; found by the #666 final review. Separate iOS PR per the workspace rule (web first, then the iOS snapshot). Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

evidence.summary: Final review of #666, item 1: no open RF record owned the iOS snapshot refresh after RF-132.
